title: Fix concurrent group access to prevent NullPointerException

comments.text: Style note: the null-handling pattern here differs from getSubGroupsStream(), which calls getDelegateForUpdate() when it hits a null model. Suggests aligning with the existing error handling pattern.

Logic note: the reader thread is started but never joined, so the test could finish before the reader completes. Suggested change: store the thread in a variable, call start(), then join with a 5-second timeout after deleting groups.
Syntax note: the variable name "groupUuuids" has a typo and should be "groupUuids".
